tools.name: emi
tools.description: Takes a loan amount, annual rate and tenure, plus optional prepayments or a rate change, and returns the monthly EMI, total interest and year-by-year schedule for an Indian home loan. Example input: {"principal":5000000,"annualRate":8.5,"years":20}

tools.name: sensitivity
tools.description: Takes a loan amount, annual rate and tenure and returns how the EMI and total interest change when the rate moves up or down by small steps. Example input: {"principal":5000000,"annualRate":8.5,"years":20}

tools.name: eligibility
tools.description: Takes net monthly income, existing EMIs, annual rate and tenure and returns the maximum EMI and home loan amount a borrower qualifies for. Example input: {"netMonthlyIncome":150000,"existingEmis":10000,"annualRate":8.5,"years":20}

tools.name: rentVsBuy
tools.description: Takes rent, price, down payment, loan terms and growth assumptions and returns the year-by-year net worth of buying against renting, with the break-even year. tools.name: balanceTransfer
tools.description: Takes the outstanding balance, months left, current and new rates and a fee and returns both EMIs, the net saving and the break-even months of a balance transfer. Example input: {"outstanding":4000000,"remainingMonths":180,"currentRate":9.25,"newRate":8.4,"processingFee":20000}

tools.name: downPayment
tools.description: Takes a property price and returns the loan-to-value ratio, maximum loan, minimum down payment and approximate stamp duty plus registration. Example input: {"price":7500000}
